Beyond the gene polymorphisms discussed here, many other
genes involved in glucose regulation and insulin secretion are
also under investigation for potential roles in inﬂ uencing risk of 
type 2 diabetes and diabetes complications.45
Cardiovascular Disease
Examples of interactions of dietary components with the 
genome in modulation of lipid metabolism are many. One of 
the most illustrative and well-studied examples involves poly-
unsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) and their derivatives, which
are ligands for (i.e., they bind to and activate) the peroxisome 
proliferator-activated receptors (PPARs). PPARγ was intro-
duced earlier as an example in the section on diabetes. PPARs
(alpha, gamma, and delta) are nuclear receptors, meaning they 
reside in the nucleus. When activated by binding of a ligand
